race.comment: PERCIDIAN (14) is normally hitting the line late in his races, so he should be suited by racing over a middle distance for the first time here. Rochelle Milnes sticks with him, and so do we. Each way. SPANGLED SIPPER (13) ran on strongly late over 1500m at Gawler last time out, and she has the blinkers on for the first time. A 5.5kg weight drop helps, and she is worth including in all top 4 combos. FIORA BLUE (3) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1400m at Murray Bridge. Fitter so can feature in the finish. CALLISTEMON (7) has been in the market at her last couple of starts but hasn't made an impression, last start running fourth at Mildura. Rates as a place chance.
